contract: Five independent gates select record raw/processed input and wet shared Track FX/dry playback paths.
Input and playback application revisions must both be confirmed before a gate is displayed as applied.
Private per-track FX precede the shared wet/dry split; meters describe actual software playback taps.

scopedChecks.behavior: Native gate acknowledgement/getter and FX readback selector tests, together with semantic Memory runtime tests, passed in a32-test focused run.

limitations: Simulation and software-node tests do not establish hardware routing equivalence.
Final gate/render regressions after pending core fixes are not yet complete.
